scenario_description:
Objective: Notice a brief chance to add a free windowsill herb kit to Lidia’s already planned senior-center visit.
Emerging Need: The extra is only worthwhile once a real cancellation kit exists, the visit still has enough departure slack, and her saved plant preference authorizes the choice.
Decision Context: The schedule, pickup desk contact, ride update, and cancellation email together make a same-site reservation feasible; the prior note identifies the acceptable kit type.
Consequence: Timely coordination could add a small enjoyable take-home benefit, while doing nothing simply leaves the craft-circle visit unchanged after the returned kits are reassigned.

parameter.title: Lidia senior-center craft circle visit
parameter.description: Camila plans to bring Lidia to the Thursday craft circle and drive her home afterward.
parameter.location: Hart Senior Center, 915 27th St, Sacramento, CA

parameter.name: Hart Senior Center Garden Guild Desk
parameter.notes: Handles lobby pickup questions for seasonal plant-kit distributions during center activities.

parameter.content: Thursday still works. I can keep Mom at Hart until about 12:35 if there is anything quick in the lobby after craft circle, but I need to leave right after that.

parameter.subject: Returned plant kits available at today’s Hart craft circle
parameter.body: Two no-cost windowsill kits were returned for today’s craft-circle attendees. A family coordinator may reply before 11:45 with the attendee name and one kit choice: edible herb trio or flowering patio mix. Reserved kits can be picked up at the lobby desk between 12:10 and 12:30 today.

parameter.subject: Hart plant-kit reservations closed for today
parameter.body: The returned craft-circle plant kits have now been reassigned. The lobby desk will not be taking additional same-day reservations or holding unclaimed kits after 11:45.
